title: Everyday Verbs: Roll The Dice
description: Roll the dice, find the question on the 6x6 board and practice real-life conversational English with everyday verbs.

thumbnail.alt: Two colorful dice on a classroom conversation board
thumbnail.prompt: Two colorful wooden dice showing dots on a conversation game board with speech bubbles. Flat vector illustration, soft warm earthy palette (terracotta, sage green, ochre, muted blue, cream) with a small touch of muted gold, very subtle, even paper grain, simple rounded shapes, gentle soft lighting, centered composition with generous empty space around the subject, mid-tone background that works on both dark and light pages. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no real or famous people, no watermark. Full-bleed flat background color from edge to edge: no frame, no border, no round or oval vignette, no wreath, no mandala or ornament in the middle of the image. aspect ratio 16:10

content.instructions: Roll both dice to choose a question from the board, or click any square to answer. Speak for up to 1 minute!
